title: Workstation Audio Subsystem & Realtek Driver Reset

purpose.text: Automated workflow to diagnose and reset the Windows Audio subsystem and Realtek driver stack without a full reboot.
purpose.quote: Automated workflow to diagnose and reset the Windows Audio subsystem and Realtek driver stack withou

scope.text: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.

roles.responsibility: Executes Workstation Audio Subsystem & Realtek Driver Reset

steps.action: Query active audio device hardware instance ID to verify audio endpoint presence.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'AudioEndpoint', set variables.audio_endpoint_present = true, else set variables.audio_endpoint_present = false
steps.quote: Query active audio device hardware instance ID to verify audio endpoint presence.

steps.action: Forcefully stop Windows Audio engine and Audio Endpoint Builder services.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.services_stopped = true, else set variables.services_stopped = false
steps.quote: Forcefully stop Windows Audio engine and Audio Endpoint Builder services.

steps.action: Restart the core Realtek High Definition Audio driver stack.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.driver_restarted = true, else set variables.driver_restarted = false
steps.quote: Restart the core Realtek High Definition Audio driver stack.

steps.action: Start the Windows Audio service daemon.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.services_started = true, else set variables.services_started = false
steps.quote: Start the Windows Audio service daemon.

steps.action: Verify audio subsystem operational status responds with Running.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Running', set variables.audio_service_running = true, else set variables.audio_service_running = false
steps.quote: Verify audio subsystem operational status responds with Running.
